outcome: Hypotensive response (incidence and severity of hypotension)
cohort: 84 healthy parturients (aged 18-35 years, American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status II) scheduled for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic administration of ondansetron and palonosetron were equally effective in reducing the incidence and severity of hypotension in healthy parturients following spinal anesthesia for elective LSCS, with no significant difference in neonatal Apgar scores.
